controls.reference_claim_scope: Focused AI inventory, not exhaustive/human oracle; audit omitted relevant evidence
controls.stronger_reader: Optional small diagnostic subset, never mixed with primary same-reader estimates

decision_logic: Target-only raw poor: fix/calibrate reader and taxonomy before blaming memory
Reference claims good, learned claims poor: prioritize extraction and source binding
Lookup rescues learned claims: evidence access is a bottleneck
Reference claims poor while raw works: revise representation granularity/reader compatibility
All representations work offline but claims unavailable: scheduling/latency bottleneck
Current-support good but event classification poor: probe/task mismatch, not proof of alarm benefit

execution.budget_failure: Counted as invalid, never silently omitted
execution.lookup: model-selected visible IDs, <=2 rounds, <=2 records per round
execution.reference_input: focused reference facts plus recent raw buffer

limitations: Posthoc development on four project-seen authored tasks; no generalization claim
AI nonblind candidate labels require review; not actual alarm or irreversible-lock labels
No honest strong-correlation estimate from four tasks or four ablation points
Remote tokenizer preflight and GPU inference still pending
No new GPU inference, training, synthetic execution or push performed

phases.name: reader_calibration
phases.rule: Reuse existing v1 outputs as baseline; compare per-task and paired cases

contrasts: agent says done vs observed test success
exit-zero with zero tests vs nonzero-count passing suite
same tested version vs edit after last passing test
phases.name: controlled_contrasts
phases.rule: Constructed controls clearly separated from real native runs; validate both sides

phases.design: Restore stage x claim on actual risk decisions after diagnostic fixes
metrics: risk recall at matched false alarms
false alarms on recovery and qualified completion
phases.name: heldout_failure_and_timing
phases.timing: Use validated arrival timestamps or preregistered multi-rate sensitivity; report availability, coverage and queue load

primary_hypotheses: H1: extraction loses or changes risk-relevant source facts
H2: facts survive but source/time binding and reader access fail
H3: fine historical classification and current evidence support differ
H4: seal/publication lag prevents timely use even when representation works
